objective: Generate local false-positive regression catalog artifacts from the implemented contract so maintainers and AI IDEs can consume JSON/Markdown evidence without changing runtime detection behavior or suppressing findings.
acceptance: Add a local artifact generator that writes false-positive regression catalog JSON and Markdown under an ignored RepoAssure artifact directory.

Ensure generated artifacts include fixture categories, expected finding snapshots, severity/rationale review fields, maintainer decision fields, redaction metadata, and read order for AI IDE consumption.
Add unit or integration tests for generator output shape, Markdown readability, redaction, and no target repo write boundary.
Do not modify runtime detectors, do not suppress findings, do not downgrade severities automatically, and do not write target repositories.
